subject: Re: Pilot demo — VP & CTO compact window and coverage plan
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@soltech.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot demo — exec presence (VP + CTO) and tight window

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. We’re keen to run a concise pilot to evaluate latency/cost tradeoffs for our inference surfaces and would like both our VP of Product (Anil Desai) and CTO (Priya Shah) at the demo if possible. Our calendars are tight — we have one 45-minute slot open the week of Oct 4–8 where both can join.

Can Redwood do a 30–40 minute focused walkthrough aimed at decision-makers (concise run of show + a short Q&A)? If yes, would you also share who would stand in if one of our execs gets pulled? We prefer one person from your side who can cover architecture and one who can cover pricing/unit economics.

Attached: executive-availability.ics (shows the proposed window on our side).

Best,
Lena
Lena Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
SolTech Innovations
attachments: soltech-exec-availability.ics

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@soltech.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — exec presence (VP + CTO) and tight window

Hi Lena —

Appreciate the note. We can absolutely do a focused session for execs. Proposed plan: 30 minutes demo + 10 minutes Q&A — covers high-level architecture, a short live demo of inference across two deployment modes (Hosted vs Dedicated), and cost/latency tradeoffs.

Availability: we have two candidate slots in that week that map to your attached window. Please confirm which one matches the .ics you shared:
- Tue Oct 5, 11:00–11:45 AM ET (40 min) — Lina (our solutions lead) and I can join
- Wed Oct 6, 4:00–4:45 PM ET (40 min) — Marcus can lead architecture + I’ll cover pricing and rollout playbook

Standby plan: If either of your execs needs to step out, Marcus Lin will be designated to continue deep-technical Q&A; Rachel Kim can cover contract/next-step logistics and procurement touch points. I’m attaching a short run-of-show and lightweight deck for exec audiences (demo-outline-15min.pdf). Also attaching a high-level SOC2 summary we can share ahead of the meeting if security wants to review (SOC2-summary-highlevel.pdf).

If you confirm the slot, we’ll send a calendar invite with a brief agenda and a one-page mutual action plan so both teams are aligned on success criteria for the pilot.

Thanks — talk soon,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
attachments: demo-outline-15min.pdf; SOC2-summary-highlevel.pdf

From: Lena Park <lena.park@soltech.io>

Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 07:21:00 -04:00

Mina — thanks for the options and the quick deck. Wed Oct 6 at 4:00–4:45 PM ET works best for us. Attaching the confirmed .ics from our side (soltech-exec-availability.ics).

One ask before the demo: can you include a single slide that summarizes expected per-token cost delta between Hosted and Dedicated for a 1M token/day workload? Our CFO will look at that tight number during the meeting. If you can call that out as an approximate range that would be helpful.

Also — good to know Marcus will cover technical follow-ups. If one of our execs is delayed, we’ll keep the meeting and have him continue.

Lena
attachments: soltech-exec-availability.ics

- 4:05–4:20 PM: Live demo (Marcus) — Hosted vs Dedicated comparison (latency/cost highlights)
- 4:20–4:35 PM: Pricing/rollout playbook and mutual action plan (Mina & Rachel)
- 4:35–4:45 PM: Q&A / next steps

Standby coverage: Marcus will lead if Priya/Anil need to step out; Rachel will keep procurement notes and DocuSign checklist ready. I’ll send the invite with agenda, the small deck, and a HubSpot action item linking the pilot to SOL-2026-09-PILOT.
